entities.name: Pierre-Célestin Tshitoko Mamba
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pierre-Célestin Tshitoko Mamba is a Congolese Catholic prelate who is the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Luebo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since 7 January 2006. Before that, from 22 August 1982 until he was appointed bishop, he was a priest of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Kananga. He was appointed bishop on 7 January 2006 by Pope Benedict XVI. He was consecrated as bishop on 25 March 2006.
